f.title: Apply the core principles to safety communications (message, audience, timing, coordination)
f.statement: Core principles to be taken into account when communicating medicine safety information to HCPs or the public: give clear, accurate, consistent messages fit for purpose and deliver the information to the target audience at the right time so appropriate action can be taken; use language suited to the target audience (e.g. patients, HCPs) taking into account different levels of knowledge and information needs while keeping accuracy and consistency; assess the need for communication throughout the pharmacovigilance and risk-management process, as part of risk assessment and minimisation measures; ensure adequate coordination and cooperation between the parties involved in publication (e.g. TITCK and MAHs).

rows.quote: İlaç güvenliliği ile ilgili bilgilerin sağlık mesleği mensuplarına ya da halka duyurulmasında göz önünde bulundurulması gereken temel ilkeler şunlardır:  Amacına uygun, net, doğru, tutarlı mesajlar verilmesi ve uygun önlemlerin alınabilmesi için bilginin hedef kitleye doğru zamanda ulaştırılması,  İletilen bilgilerin doğruluk ve tutarlılığını da muhafaza ederek farklı bilgi seviyeleri ve bilgi ihtiyacını dikkate alacak şekilde ilgili hedef kitleye göre (örn; hastalar ve sağlık mesleği mensupları gibi) uygun bir dil kullanılması, 2    İletişim ihtiyacının olup olmadığının tüm farmakovijilans ve risk yönetimi süreci boyunca değerlendirilmesi ve riski değerlendirme ve en aza indirme önlemlerinin bir parçası olması,    Yayınlama sürecinde yer alan farklı taraflar (örn; Kurum ve ruhsat sahipleri) arasında yeterli koordinasyon ve işbirliğinin sağlanması,
rows.review_note: Review: Added: 2.2 core principles missed by extractor; Mandatory per "göz önünde bulundurulması gereken" (gerekir). Split into three rows (0035, 0036, 0045) for quote length; quote spans page number "2". Double-check: below 90: "göz önünde bulundurulması gereken" principles read as Mandatory is a judgement call; actor inferred from 2.2 scope; quote spans page number "2". Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The core principles that must be taken into account when communicating information on medicine safety to healthcare professionals or the public are: giving messages that are fit for purpose, clear, accurate and consistent, and delivering the information to the target audience at the right time so that appropriate measures can be taken; using language appropriate to the relevant target audience (e.g. patients and healthcare professionals), taking into account different levels of knowledge and information needs while maintaining the accuracy and consistency of the information conveyed; [page 2] assessing the need for communication throughout the whole pharmacovigilance and risk-management process, and communication being part of the risk assessment and risk-minimisation measures; ensuring adequate coordination and cooperation between the different parties involved in the publication process (e.g. the Agency and marketing authorisation holders);

f.title: Apply the core principles to safety communications (benefit context, uncertainty, quantitative risk)
f.statement: Further core principles: present information on risks in the context of the medicine's benefits, including available relevant information on seriousness, severity, frequency, risk factors, time to onset, reversibility and recovery time of adverse reactions; address uncertainties about the safety concern; where appropriate, give information on competing risks such as the risk of not being treated; use the most appropriate quantitative measures when describing and comparing risks (e.g. state absolute and not only relative risk) and use denominators of equal size when comparing risks (graphs and other tools may also be used to present risks and/or benefit-risk).

rows.quote:    Risklerle ilgili bilgilerin ilacın yararları bağlamında sunulması ve advers reaksiyonların ciddiyeti, şiddeti, görülme sıklığı, risk faktörleri, ortaya çıkma süresi, geriye döndürülebilirliği, iyileşme süresi hakkında mevcut ve ilgili bilgileri içermesi,    Güvenlilik endişesi ile ilgili belirsizliklerin ele alınması,    Uygun olduğunda, tedavi edilmeme riski gibi karşıt riskler hakkında bilgi verilmesi,    Riskleri tarif ve mukayese ederken en uygun nicel ölçütlerin kullanılması (örn; yalnız bağıl riskin değil, mutlak riskin de belirtilmesi gibi), riskleri karşılaştırırken, paydanın büyüklük bakımından eşit olması (Risk ve/veya yarar/risk dengesinin sunumunda grafikler gibi diğer araçlar da kullanılabilir),
rows.review_note: Review: Added: second part of 2.2 core principles; same level reasoning as 0035. Parenthetical "kullanılabilir" (graphs) is permissive. Double-check: below 90: list items without the 2.2 lead-in; Mandatory level is a judgement call carried from the lead-in; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Presenting information on risks in the context of the medicine's benefits, and including available and relevant information on the seriousness, severity, frequency, risk factors, time to onset, reversibility and recovery time of adverse reactions; addressing uncertainties relating to the safety concern; where appropriate, giving information on competing risks, such as the risk of not being treated; using the most appropriate quantitative measures when describing and comparing risks (e.g. stating not only relative risk but also absolute risk), and, when comparing risks, the denominators being equal in size (other tools such as graphics may also be used to present risk and/or the benefit/risk balance);

f.title: Apply the core principles to safety communications (consultation, follow-up, effectiveness, privacy)
f.statement: Further core principles: particularly for complex safety concerns, consult patients and HCPs where possible when preparing the communication and pre-test the message; issue follow-up communication when more information on the concern is obtained (e.g. resolution of the concern or updated advice); where possible, evaluate the effectiveness of the communication (see 2.6); comply with personal data protection and confidentiality requirements.

rows.quote:    Özellikle karmaşık güvenlilik endişeleri söz konusu olduğunda, güvenlilik duyurusu hazırlanırken mümkünse hastalara ve sağlık mesleği mensuplarına danışılması ve mesajın ön teste tâbi tutulması,    Güvenlilik endişesi ile ilgili daha fazla bilgi edinilmesi halinde, takip duyurusu yapılması (güvenlilik endişelerinin çözümlenmesi ya da tavsiyelerin güncellenmesi gibi),    Mümkün olduğunda güvenlilik duyurusunun etkinliğinin değerlendirilmesi (bkz. 2.6),    Kişisel veri koruma ve gizliliği gerekliliklerine uyulması.
rows.review_note: Review: Added: third part of 2.2 core principles; same level reasoning as 0035. Double-check: below 90: list items without the 2.2 lead-in; Mandatory level is a judgement call carried from the lead-in; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where possible, consulting patients and healthcare professionals and pre-testing the message when preparing the safety communication, particularly for complex safety concerns; issuing a follow-up communication when more information on the safety concern is obtained (such as resolution of safety concerns or updated recommendations); where possible, evaluating the effectiveness of the safety communication (see 2.6); complying with personal data protection and confidentiality requirements.

f.title: Deliver the same safety information to practising and clinical-trial HCPs simultaneously
f.statement: Appropriate information on any safety issue should reach healthcare professionals at the same time, whether they are in practice or involved in clinical trials.

rows.quote: Gerek mesleğini icra eden, gerekse klinik araştırmalarda yer alan sağlık mesleği mensuplarına, her türlü güvenlilik sorunu ile ilgili uygun bilgiler aynı anda ulaştırılmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and TITCK) inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Appropriate information on any safety issue should reach healthcare professionals at the same time, whether they are in practice or involved in clinical trials.

f.title: Keep safety communications objective and not misleading
f.statement: Information in a safety communication must not be misleading and must be presented objectively [Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products Article 22(12)].
f.legal_basis: Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products Art 22(12)

rows.quote: Güvenlilik duyurusunda yer alan bilgiler yanıltıcı olmamalı ve tarafsız olarak sunulmalıdır [İlaçların Güvenliliği Hakkında Yönetmelik’in 22 (12)].
rows.review_note: Review: Kept Mandatory although wording is "-malı/-memeli": first clause restates Regulation Art 22(12); added legal_basis. Promotion ban clause is guidance-level wording. Double-check: Split: kept only the non-misleading/objective clause as Mandatory because the quote itself cites Regulation Art 22(12) despite "-malı" wording; promotion-ban clause ("içermemelidir", no citation) moved to new row 0046 as Recommended. Below 90: Mandatory rests on the cited article, not the modal; actor inferred. Bilingual pass: level kept Mandatory although the verb is '-malı' (should): the sentence restates the binding Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products Art 22(12), which it cites. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; Mandatory kept only because the quote explicitly restates and cites the binding Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products Art 22(12); the verb itself is "-malı", so the level is a judgement call and stays below 90.
rows.quote_en: The information in a safety communication should not be misleading and should be presented objectively [Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products, Article 22(12)].

f.title: Keep safety communications free of promotional content
f.statement: A safety communication should not contain any promotional statement or material for the medicinal product.

rows.quote: Güvenlilik iletişimi ilacın tanıtımına yönelik herhangi bir cümle ya da materyal içermemelidir.
rows.review_note: Double-check: Added: split from 0002; "içermemelidir" = Recommended; no article cited for this clause. Quote proves statement; actor per 2.4 scope (MAH and TITCK). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A safety communication should not contain any sentence or material aimed at promoting the medicine.

f.title: Include new benefit-risk information and the reason for communicating
f.statement: Taking into account the principles in 2.2, a safety communication should include important new information affecting the benefit-risk balance under any condition of use, and a clear explanation to the target audience of why the safety communication is needed.

rows.quote: Güvenlilik duyurusunda 2.2.’de sayılan temel ilkeler dikkate alınarak, aşağıdaki hususların yer alması sağlanmalıdır: 3  Herhangi bir kullanım koşulunda, ilaçların yarar/risk dengesi üzerinde etkisi ortaya çıkan önemli yeni bilgiler,  Hedef kitleye, güvenlilik iletişiminde bulunmaya duyulan ihtiyacın nedeninin net açıklaması,
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote spans page number "3"; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Taking into account the core principles listed in 2.2, it should be ensured that the safety communication includes the following: [page 3] important new information that emerges on the benefit/risk balance of medicines under any condition of use; a clear explanation to the target audience of the reason for the need to issue the safety communication;

f.title: Include advice, agreement statement, label changes, references and reporting reminder
f.statement: Safety communication content should further include: recommendations to HCPs and patients on how to deal with the concern; where applicable, a statement of the agreement reached between MAH and TITCK on the information communicated; information on proposed changes to product information (e.g. SmPC or PIL); any additional information on use or other data to tailor the message; where relevant, a list of literature references or sources of more detailed information; and, where necessary, a reminder that suspected adverse reactions should be reported to TÜFAM.

rows.quote: Güvenlilik endişesiyle nasıl başa çıkılabileceği konusunda sağlık mesleği mensuplarına ve hastalara tavsiyeler,  Duyurusu yapılan güvenlilik bilgilerine ilişkin ruhsat sahibi ve Kurum arasında varılmış olan mutabakata dair beyan (uygulanabilir olduğunda),  Ürün bilgilerinde (örn; KÜB ya da KT) yapılması önerilen değişiklikler hakkında bilgi,  Mesajın hedef kitleye uyarlanması için ilacın kullanımı veya diğer veriler hakkında herhangi bir ek bilgi,  İlgili olduğunda, kaynak literatür listesi ya da daha detaylı bilgi edinilebilecek kaynaklara atıf,  Gerektiğinde, şüpheli advers reaksiyonların Türkiye Farmakovijilans Merkezi (TÜFAM)’ne bildirilmesi gerektiğine dair hatırlatma.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: list items quoted without their "sağlanmalıdır" lead-in (in 0003); actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Recommendations to healthcare professionals and patients on how to deal with the safety concern; a statement of the agreement reached between the marketing authorisation holder and the Agency on the safety information communicated (where applicable); information on proposed changes to the product information (e.g. SmPC or PL); any additional information on the use of the medicine or other data, in order to tailor the message to the target audience; where relevant, a list of literature references or a reference to sources where more detailed information can be obtained; where necessary, a reminder that suspected adverse reactions must be reported to the Turkish Pharmacovigilance Centre (TÜFAM).

f.title: Use the range of available communication tools to reach target audiences
f.statement: To reach target audiences and meet their growing expectations, an effort is required to make use of the increasingly varied tools available for communicating medicine safety (the duty is to endeavour to use them).

rows.quote: Hedef kitlelere ulaşabilmek ve onların artan beklentilerini karşılayabilmek için, ilaç güvenliliği ile ilgili duyuruların yapılmasında giderek daha çeşitli hale gelen bu araçlardan yararlanılmaya çalışılması gerekmektedir.
rows.review_note: Review: Level Mandatory confirmed ("gerekmektedir"); duty is an effort obligation ("yararlanılmaya çalışılması"). Double-check: below 90: "gerekmektedir" kept Mandatory per level mapping, but the duty is effort-only ("yararlanılmaya çalışılması") and vague; no actor named in the quote (inferred); statement reworded to reflect effort duty. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In order to reach target audiences and meet their growing expectations, it is necessary to endeavour to make use of these increasingly diverse tools when issuing communications on medicine safety.

f.title: Keep DHPCs free of promotional content
f.statement: A healthcare professional information letter (DHPC) should not contain any material or statement that could be regarded as promotional, nor give the impression of a commercial purpose.

rows.quote: “Sağlık mesleği mensubu bilgilendirme mektubu” tanıtım olarak kabul edilebilecek herhangi bir materyal veya beyan içermemeli ya da ticari amaçlı olduğu izlenimini bırakmamalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: actor MAH implied by DHPC context, not named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A "healthcare professional information letter" should not contain any material or statement that could be regarded as promotion, nor give the impression of having a commercial purpose.

f.title: Do not use DHPCs for non-urgent or minor information
f.statement: DHPCs should not be used for safety information that does not require urgent communication or for information that is not important to communicate individually to HCPs, such as SmPC changes with no effect on appropriate conditions of use.

rows.quote: Acil iletişim gerektirmeyen güvenlilik bilgileri için ve ilacın uygun kullanım koşullarına etkisi olmayan KÜB değişiklikleri gibi bireysel olarak sağlık mesleği mensuplarına iletilmesi önem arz etmeyen bilgilerin yayılmasında, SMMDİ kullanılmamalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive, actor implied by DHPC context. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A DHPC should not be used for safety information that does not require urgent communication, nor for disseminating information that is not important to communicate individually to healthcare professionals, such as SmPC changes that have no effect on the appropriate conditions of use of the medicine.

f.title: Agree DHPC content and communication plan with TITCK before dissemination
f.statement: The MAH and TITCK cooperate in preparing the DHPC text. Agreement between them must be reached before the MAH issues the DHPC, covering both the content of the information and the communication plan, including intended recipients and the dissemination timetable.

rows.quote: SMMDİ metni hazırlama sürecinde ruhsat sahibi ile Kurum işbirliği yapar. Ruhsat sahibi tarafından SMMDİ yayınlanmadan önce söz konusu taraflar arasında mutabakat sağlanmış olması gerekir. Bu mutabakat; hem bilgilerin içeriğini (bkz. 2.4), hem de hedeflenen alıcılar ve SMMDİ’in yayınlanma takvimini de içine alan iletişim planını kapsayacaktır.
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("olması gerekir", "kapsayacaktır"); removed duplicate submissions-2 from consulted. Double-check: Confirmed Mandatory ("gerekir", "kapsayacaktır"); actor named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder and the Agency cooperate in the process of preparing the DHPC text. Agreement must have been reached between these parties before the DHPC is issued by the marketing authorisation holder. This agreement shall cover both the content of the information (see 2.4) and the communication plan, including the intended recipients and the timetable for issuing the DHPC.

f.title: Use the DHPC template and its guidance notes
f.statement: When drafting a DHPC, the relevant template (Annex I and Annex II) and the guidance in the notes within the template must be applied as required.

rows.quote: SMMDİ kaleme alınırken ilgili şablon (bkz. Ek I ve Ek II) ve şablon içerisindeki notlarda yer verilen yönlendirmelerin gereken şekilde uygulanması gerekmektedir.
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("gerekmektedir"). Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor implied. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When drafting the DHPC, the relevant template (see Annex I and Annex II) and the guidance given in the notes within the template must be applied as required.

f.title: Give a single consistent message for multi-MAH or class DHPCs
f.statement: Where the active substance concerned has more than one MAH and/or the DHPC concerns a class of medicines, a single consistent message should be given.

rows.quote: SMMDİ’ye konu etkin maddenin birden fazla ruhsat sahibi olduğu ve/veya belirli bir ilaç sınıfını ilgilendirdiği durumlarda, tutarlı tek bir mesaj verilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor implied; multi-MAH coordination. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where the active substance concerned by the DHPC has more than one marketing authorisation holder and/or the DHPC concerns a particular class of medicines, a single consistent message should be given.

f.title: Consider involving HCP associations in drafting the DHPC
f.statement: Where possible and appropriate, involving relevant healthcare professional associations in drafting the DHPC may be considered, to make sure the information is useful and suited to the target audience.

rows.quote: Mümkün ve uygun olduğunda, sağlanan bilgilerin yararlı ve hedef kitleye uygun olduğundan emin olmak için SMMDİ metni hazırlama sürecine, ilgili sağlık mesleği mensubu derneklerinin de dâhil edilmesi düşünülebilir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive "düşünülebilir", actor implied. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where possible and appropriate, involving relevant healthcare professional associations in the process of preparing the DHPC text may be considered, to make sure the information provided is useful and suited to the target audience.

f.title: Use complementary communication tools alongside the DHPC
f.statement: Consistent with the principle of consistent information, other communication tools and channels complementing the DHPC may be used.

rows.quote: İletilen bilgilerin tutarlı olması ilkesi çerçevesinde, SMMDİ’yi tamamlar nitelikte diğer iletişim araç ve kanallarından da yararlanılabilir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive "yararlanılabilir", actor implied. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Within the principle of consistency of the information conveyed, other communication tools and channels complementing the DHPC may also be used.

f.title: Consider issuing a DHPC on suspension, use restrictions, new warnings or new risk data
f.statement: The option of issuing a DHPC needs to be considered in situations including: suspension or revocation of the authorisation for safety reasons; an important change in use due to restriction of indication, a new contraindication or a change in recommended dose for safety reasons; inclusion of important new warnings or precautions in product information; and new data on a previously unknown risk or a change in the frequency or severity of a known risk.

rows.quote: SMMDİ yayınlama seçeneğinin değerlendirilmesi gereken durumlar aşağıdaki gibidir:  İlaç ruhsatının güvenlilikle ilgili nedenlerden ötürü askıya alınması ya da iptal edilmesi,  Güvenlilikle ilgili nedenlerden ötürü endikasyonun kısıtlanması, yeni bir kontrendikasyonun ortaya çıkması veya tavsiye edilen dozda değişiklik yapılmasına bağlı olarak ilacın kullanımında önemli bir değişiklik olması,  Ürün bilgilerinde önemli yeni uyarılara ya da kullanım tedbirlerine yer verilmesi,  Önceden bilinmeyen bir risk tespit edildiğine veya bilinen bir riskin sıklık ya da şiddetinde değişiklik olduğuna dair yeni verilere ulaşılması,
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("değerlendirilmesi gereken"): duty is to consider a DHPC, not to issue one. Double-check: below 90: "değerlendirilmesi gereken" Mandatory-to-consider is a judgement reading; actor (MAH and TITCK) inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Situations in which the option of issuing a DHPC needs to be considered are as follows: suspension or revocation of the marketing authorisation of a medicine for safety-related reasons; an important change in the use of the medicine due to restriction of an indication, a new contraindication or a change in the recommended dose for safety-related reasons; inclusion of important new warnings or precautions for use in the product information; availability of new data showing that a previously unknown risk has been identified or that there has been a change in the frequency or severity of a known risk;

f.title: Consider issuing a DHPC on reduced efficacy, new recommendations or ongoing potential-risk assessment
f.statement: Situations in which issuing a DHPC needs to be considered also include: substantiated knowledge that the medicine is not as effective as previously thought; new recommendations to prevent or treat adverse reactions or to avoid misuse or medication errors; and ongoing assessment of an important potential risk where available data are not yet sufficient for regulatory action (in which case the DHPC should encourage close monitoring and reporting of the issue in clinical practice and, where possible, provide information on how to minimise the potential risk).

rows.quote: İlacın önceden düşünüldüğü ölçüde etkili olmadığına dair kanıtlanmış bilgilere ulaşılması,  Bir ilacın advers reaksiyonlarını önlemek ya da tedavi etmek veya kötüye kullanım veya ilaç kullanım hatalarından kaçınmak için yeni tavsiyelerde bulunulması,  Bir tarihte mevcut olan bilgilerin idari işlem başlatmaya henüz yeterli olmadığı önemli potansiyel bir riske ilişkin değerlendirmelerin devam ediyor olması (bu durumda SMMDİ klinik uygulamada söz konusu güvenlilik sorununun yakından takip edilmesini ve advers reaksiyonun bildirilmesini, hatta mümkünse potansiyel riskin nasıl en aza indirileceğine dair bilgilerin iletilmesini teşvik etmelidir).
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("değerlendirilmesi gereken" carries over from the list lead-in in 0013). Double-check: below 90: list items without the lead-in (in 0013); level carried over; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Availability of substantiated knowledge that the medicine is not as effective as previously considered; new recommendations for preventing or treating adverse reactions of a medicine, or for avoiding misuse or medication errors; ongoing assessment of an important potential risk for which the data available at a given time are not yet sufficient to initiate regulatory action (in this case the DHPC should encourage close monitoring of the safety issue in clinical practice and reporting of the adverse reaction, and if possible convey information on how to minimise the potential risk).

f.title: TITCK may issue a DHPC or require the MAH to issue one
f.statement: Where it finds it necessary for continued safe and effective use of a medicine, TITCK may issue a DHPC or ask the MAH to issue a DHPC.

rows.quote: Kurum, bir ilacın güvenli ve etkili bir biçimde kullanılmaya devam edilebilmesi için gerekli bulduğu durumlarda, SMMDİ yayınlayabilir veya ruhsat sahibinden bir SMMDİ yayınlamasını isteyebilir.
rows.review_note: Review: Removed duplicate submissions-2 from informed; Permitted ("-ebilir") confirmed. Double-check: below 90: authority-led permission; the company step (issue a DHPC when TITCK asks) is implied, not stated as a duty. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The Agency may issue a DHPC, or may ask the marketing authorisation holder to issue a DHPC, where it finds this necessary for the continued safe and effective use of a medicine.

f.title: Time DHPC distribution carefully without delaying urgent information
f.statement: The proposed date and time of distribution should be carefully calculated; distribution at the beginning of the week is considered ideal, but urgent information should not be delayed for that reason alone.

rows.quote: Dağıtım için önerilen tarih ve saat dikkatle hesaplanmalıdır; ideal olarak kabul edilen, bir SMMDİ’nin hafta başında dağıtılmasıdır; ancak sırf bu nedenle acil bir bilginin dağıtılması geciktirilmemelidir (mektup dağıtımına ilişkin ayrıntılı bilgi Ek I ve Ek II’de açıklanmıştır).
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive, actor implied. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The proposed date and time of distribution should be carefully calculated; distributing a DHPC at the beginning of the week is regarded as ideal; however, distribution of urgent information should not be delayed for this reason alone (detailed information on letter distribution is given in Annex I and Annex II).

f.title: Inform TITCK when a foreign authority requires a DHPC for a product authorised in Turkey
f.statement: Where a health authority outside Turkey requires a DHPC to be issued in its country for a medicine also authorised in Turkey, the MAH should inform TITCK; this forms part of the legal requirement for MAHs to notify competent authorities of new information that may affect the benefit-risk balance.

rows.quote: Türkiye dışındaki bir sağlık otoritesinin Türkiye’de de ruhsatlı bir ilaca ilişkin kendi ülkelerinde bir SMMDİ yayınlanmasını istediği durumlarda, ruhsat sahibi Kurumu bilgilendirmelidir. Bu işlem, ruhsat sahiplerinin bir ilacın yarar/risk dengesini etkileyebilecek yeni bilgileri yetkili otoritelere bildirmeleri yönündeki yasal gerekliliğin bir parçasını oluşturur.
rows.review_note: Review: Recommended kept per "bilgilendirmelidir"; the source links it to the legal duty to notify new benefit-risk information but cites no article. Double-check: Confirmed Recommended ("bilgilendirmelidir"), actor named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where a health authority outside Türkiye requires a DHPC to be issued in its own country for a medicine that is also authorised in Türkiye, the marketing authorisation holder should inform the Agency. This forms part of the legal requirement for marketing authorisation holders to notify competent authorities of new information that may affect the benefit/risk balance of a medicine.

f.title: MAHs may prepare and publish press releases
f.statement: Press releases may also be prepared and published by MAHs.

rows.quote: Basın açıklamaları ruhsat sahipleri tarafından da hazırlanıp yayınlanabilir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Confirmed Permitted. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Press statements may also be prepared and published by marketing authorisation holders.

f.title: Inform TITCK before or with public disclosure of PV concerns and guarantee accuracy
f.statement: When information on pharmacovigilance concerns about the use of medicines is to be made public, TITCK is informed in advance or simultaneously, and the MAH guarantees that the information is accurate and not misleading.

rows.deadline: Before or at the same time as public disclosure
rows.quote: Ancak, ilaçların kullanımıyla ilgili farmakovijilans endişelerine dair bilgiler kamuoyuna açıklanacağı zaman Kurum önceden veya eş zamanlı olarak bilgilendirilir. Ruhsat sahibi, bu bilgilerin doğruluğunu ve yanıltıcı olmamasını garanti eder.
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory kept: prescriptive present tense ("bilgilendirilir", "garanti eder"); removed duplicate submissions-2 from consulted. Double-check: below 90: "Kurum ... bilgilendirilir" is passive and opens with "Ancak" (lead-in about MAH press releases not quoted); who informs TITCK is inferred as the MAH; Mandatory from prescriptive present tense. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: However, when information on pharmacovigilance concerns relating to the use of medicines is to be made public, the Agency is informed in advance or simultaneously. The marketing authorisation holder guarantees that this information is accurate and not misleading.

f.title: Refer in MAH press releases to TITCK regulatory actions and ongoing reviews
f.statement: MAH press releases should refer to any regulatory action TITCK may have initiated and to relevant ongoing reviews.

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahiplerinin basın açıklamaları, Kurumun başlatmış olabileceği idari tedbirlere ve devam etmekte olan ilgili incelemelere atıfta bulunmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Confirmed Recommended; actor named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Press statements of marketing authorisation holders should refer to any regulatory measures the Agency may have initiated and to related ongoing reviews.

f.title: Reference related materials and share DHPC with HCPs before the press release
f.statement: Because press releases will also be read by HCPs, patients and the public, they should refer to related communication materials. Where a DHPC is also prepared, it should preferably be shared with HCPs before the press release is published, so HCPs are better prepared to respond to patients.

rows.quote: Bu nedenle, konuya ilişkin ilgili iletişim materyallerine atıfta bulunulmalıdır. Bir SMMDİ’in de hazırlandığı durumlarda sağlık mesleği mensuplarının hastalara cevap vermeye daha hazırlıklı olabilmeleri için, tercihen bu iletişim, basın açıklamasının yayınlanmasından önce sağlık mesleği mensuplarıyla paylaşılmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote opens "Bu nedenle" without its lead-in (rationale in statement not quoted); actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: They should therefore refer to the related communication materials on the subject. Where a DHPC has also been prepared, that communication should preferably be shared with healthcare professionals before the press statement is published, so that healthcare professionals can be better prepared to respond to patients.

f.title: Keep safety information on controlled websites accessible and up to date
f.statement: TITCK and MAHs should ensure that important safety information published on websites under their control is easily accessible and understandable by the public; website information should be kept up to date and outdated information removed.

rows.quote: Kurum ve ruhsat sahipleri, kendi kontrollerinde bulunan internet sitelerinde yayınlanan önemli güvenlilik bilgilerinin halk tarafından kolayca erişilebilir ve anlaşılabilir olmasını sağlamalıdır. İnternet sitelerindeki bilgiler güncel tutulmalı, güncelliğini yitirmiş bilgiler kaldırılmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Confirmed Recommended; actors named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The Agency and marketing authorisation holders should ensure that important safety information published on websites under their control is easily accessible and understandable by the public. Information on websites should be kept up to date, and outdated information should be removed.

f.title: Do not compromise accuracy when using social media and fast channels
f.statement: When using newer, faster communication channels, particular care should be taken not to compromise the accuracy of published information.
f.clause: 2.5.6 Social media and other online communication tools

rows.quote: Daha yeni, daha hızlı iletişim kanalları kullanılırken, yayınlanan bilgilerin doğruluğundan ödün verilmemesine özellikle dikkat edilmelidir.
rows.location: 2.5.6 Social media and other online communication tools
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: no actor in the quote (inferred). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When newer, faster communication channels are used, particular care should be taken not to compromise the accuracy of the information published.

f.title: Have mechanisms to answer public enquiries based on approved product information
f.statement: TITCK and MAHs should have mechanisms to respond to individual questions on medicines from the public. Answers should take account of publicly available information and be based on TITCK-approved product information. Where questions concern individual treatment advice, the patient should be advised to consult a healthcare professional.
f.clause: 2.5.9 Responding to requests for information from the public

rows.quote: Kurumun ve ruhsat sahiplerinin, halktan bireysel olarak gelen ilaçlarla ilgili sorulara cevap vermek için mekanizmaları olmalıdır. Cevaplar, kamuya açık bilgileri dikkate almalı ve Kurum tarafından onaylanmış ürün bilgilerine dayanmalıdır. Soruların bireysel tedavi tavsiyesiyle ilgili olduğu durumlarda, hastaya bir sağlık mesleği mensubuyla görüşmesi tavsiye edilmelidir.
rows.location: 2.5.9 Responding to requests for information from the public
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Confirmed Recommended; actors named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The Agency and marketing authorisation holders should have mechanisms to respond to individual questions from the public about medicines. Answers should take account of publicly available information and should be based on the product information approved by the Agency. Where questions relate to individual treatment advice, the patient should be advised to consult a healthcare professional.

f.title: Comply with the promotional activities regulation when answering the public
f.statement: In this respect, MAHs are subject to the provisions of the Regulation on Promotional Activities of Medicinal Products for Human Use.
f.clause: 2.5.9 Responding to requests for information from the public
f.legal_basis: Regulation on Promotional Activities of Medicinal Products for Human Use

rows.quote: Bu konuda, ruhsat sahipleri “Beşeri Tıbbi Ürünlerin Tanıtım Faaliyetleri Hakkında Yönetmelik” hükümlerine tâbidir.
rows.location: 2.5.9 Responding to requests for information from the public
rows.review_note: Review: Added legal_basis; categories Regulatory+Compliance; communications as main process. Double-check: below 90: "tâbidir" is a cross-reference to another regulation; quote opens "Bu konuda" without lead-in. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In this respect, marketing authorisation holders are subject to the provisions of the "Regulation on Promotional Activities of Medicinal Products for Human Use".

f.title: Establish mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of safety communication
f.statement: Where possible, mechanisms should be established to measure the effectiveness of communication. A research-based approach is appropriate to show that safety communications meet the standard set in 2.2.

rows.quote: Mümkün olduğunda, iletişimin etkinliğini ölçmek için mekanizmalar oluşturulmalıdır. Güvenlilik iletişimlerinin 2.2’de belirlenen standardı karşıladığını ortaya koymak için araştırmaya dayalı bir yaklaşım izlenmesi uygundur.
rows.review_note: Review: Merged the following sentence (research-based approach "uygundur") into quote and statement. Double-check: below 90: passive, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where possible, mechanisms should be established to measure the effectiveness of the communication. It is appropriate to follow a research-based approach to show that safety communications meet the standard set in 2.2.

f.title: Evaluate the distribution of each DHPC
f.statement: For DHPCs, the MAH is responsible for evaluating the distribution of the DHPC it prepared.

rows.quote: SMMDİ’ler söz konusu olduğunda, hazırladığı SMMDİ’nin dağıtımını değerlendirme sorumluluğu ruhsat sahibine aittir
rows.review_note: Review: Split: responsibility clause ("sorumluluğu ... aittir", Mandatory) kept here; reporting to TITCK and corrective measures ("-meli") moved to new 0043 as Recommended. Double-check: Confirmed Mandatory ("sorumluluğu ... aittir"); actor named. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For DHPCs, the responsibility for evaluating the distribution of the DHPC it has prepared lies with the marketing authorisation holder

f.title: Report DHPC distribution results and difficulties to TITCK and take corrective action
f.statement: The MAH should report to TITCK the outcome of its evaluation of DHPC distribution and any difficulties identified (e.g. problems with the recipient list, timing or distribution mechanism); the necessary measures should be taken to correct the situation or prevent similar problems in future.

rows.quote: ve sonucunu ve varsa tespit edilen güçlükleri (örn; alıcı listesi, zamanlama veya dağıtım mekanizmasıyla ilgili sorunlar gibi) Kuruma bildirmelidir. Durumu düzeltmek ya da gelecekte benzer sıkıntılar yaşanmasını önlemek için gerekli tedbirler alınmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: Added: split from 0027 ("bildirmelidir", "alınmalıdır" = Recommended). Double-check: below 90: quote starts mid-sentence ("ve sonucunu"), actor carried from 0027. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: and [it] should report the outcome and any difficulties identified (e.g. problems with the recipient list, timing or the distribution mechanism) to the Agency. The necessary measures should be taken to correct the situation or to prevent similar problems in the future.

f.title: Apply procedures ensuring safety communications meet the core principles
f.statement: In line with the quality system requirements of GVP Module IV, necessary procedures should be applied to ensure safety communications comply with the principles in 2.2.
f.clause: 2.7 Quality system requirements for safety communication

rows.quote: İFU Modül IV- Farmakovijilans Kalite Sistemi’nde belirtilen kalite sistemi gerekliliklerine uygun olarak, güvenlilik iletişimlerinin 2.2’de altı çizilen ilkelere uygunluğunu sağlamak için gerekli prosedürler uygulanmalıdır.
rows.location: 2.7 Quality system requirements for safety communication
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In line with the quality system requirements set out in GVP Module IV – Pharmacovigilance Quality System, the necessary procedures should be applied to ensure that safety communications comply with the principles underlined in 2.2.

f.title: Quality-check communications and document review procedures
f.statement: Communications should be subject to quality controls, particularly to ensure accuracy and clarity; to this end, review procedures with defined responsibilities should be followed and documented.
f.clause: 2.7 Quality system requirements for safety communication

rows.quote: İletişim, özellikle iletişimin doğruluğunu ve açıklığını temin etmeye yönelik kalite kontrollerine tâbi tutulmalıdır. Bu amaçla, sorumluluklarının belirlendiği gözden geçirme prosedürleri izlenmeli ve belgelenmelidir.
rows.location: 2.7 Quality system requirements for safety communication
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Communication should be subject to quality controls, in particular to ensure the accuracy and clarity of the communication. To this end, review procedures with defined responsibilities should be followed and documented.

f.title: Mark additional-monitoring products with the black triangle and statement in DHPCs
f.statement: If the medicine is under additional monitoring, the black inverted equilateral triangle should be added to the title before the medicine name or active substance, and the additional monitoring statement added at the end of the letter.

rows.quote: Not: İlaç ek izlemde ise siyah eşkenar ters üçgen ilaç ismi ya da etkin maddeden önce başlığa ilâve edilmelidir.Ek izleme dair beyan metni mektubun sonuna ilâve edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: template note, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Note: If the medicine is under additional monitoring, the black inverted equilateral triangle should be added to the title before the name of the medicine or the active substance. The statement on additional monitoring should be added at the end of the letter.

f.title: Make the DHPC summary section prominent
f.statement: The font of the summary section should be larger than other DHPC sections or written in bold, and bullet points should preferably be used.

rows.quote: Açıklama: Bu bölümde kullanılan font SMMDİ’nin diğer bölümlerindekinden daha büyük olmalı ya da koyu renkli yazılmalı ve tercihen madde işaretleri kullanılmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: template note, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Explanation: The font used in this section should be larger than in the other sections of the DHPC or written in bold, and bullet points should preferably be used.

f.title: Multi-product DHPC: TITCK-letterhead letter distributed by the MAH TITCK designates
f.statement: Where the topic concerns more than one medicinal product, the letter is prepared on TITCK letterhead, distributed by the MAH designated by TITCK, and a closure report is prepared and submitted to TITCK.
f.clause: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)
f.applicability: Original language Turkish. Annex II flow chart, branch "Konunun birden fazla müstahzarı ilgilendirmesi".

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder designated by TITCK
rows.quote: Kurum tarafından Kapanış raporunun Mektup ihtiyacının          Konunun birden fazla       Kurum antetli mektup                  belirlenen ruhsat hazırlanarak Kurum a belirlenmesi             müstahzarı ilgilendirmesi       hazırlanması                      sahibi tarafından sunulması dağıtım yapılması
rows.location: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)
rows.review_note: Review: Added: multi-product branch of Annex II flow chart missed by extractor; quote is merged-column flow-chart text read across boxes (branch label, TITCK letterhead, designated MAH distributes, closure report). Prescriptive flow chart, set Mandatory. f.title: Distribute DHPCs to prescribers, hospitals, associations and faculties
f.statement: The DHPC is distributed to prescribing physicians, hospital chief physicians, relevant specialty associations and the deans of university pharmacy and medical faculties. Distribution may be made by courier, medical sales representative or e-mail (courier or e-mail is preferred in a pandemic).
f.applicability: Original language Turkish. Annex II flow chart: the box listing recipients, channels and the closure report sits beside the single-product branch; layout does not say clearly whether it also covers the multi-product branch.

rows.quote: İlaçları reçete eden hekimlere, hastane başhekimliklerine, ilgili uzmanlık derneklerine, üniversitelerin eczacılık ve tıp fakültelerinin dekanlıklarına dağıtım yapılır.  Dağıtım, kargo/ürün tanıtım temsilcisi/e-posta yoluyla yapılabilir (pandemi halinde kargo ya da e-posta yolu tercih edilir).
rows.review_note: Review: Removed "for a topic concerning a single product" from statement (flow-chart scope ambiguous, now in applicability). Mixed level: recipients prescriptive ("yapılır"), channels permissive ("yapılabilir"). Double-check: below 90: flow-chart (table-derived) text; mixed level ("yapılır" vs "yapılabilir"); single-product branch from chart layout. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Distribution is made to the physicians prescribing the medicines, hospital chief physicians' offices, the relevant specialty associations, and the deans' offices of university faculties of pharmacy and medicine. Distribution may be made by courier/medical sales representative/e-mail (in a pandemic, courier or e-mail is preferred).

f.title: Prepare DHPC on MAH letterhead signed by the QPPV and a superior
f.statement: For a topic concerning a single product, the letter is prepared on MAH letterhead, signed by the MAH's QPPV and a superior, and distributed.
f.clause: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)
f.applicability: Original language Turkish. Annex II flow chart, branch "Konunun tek bir müstahzarı ilgilendirmesi" (topic concerns a single product).

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi antetli Farmakovijilans ve Kontrole Tabi Maddeler Dairesi'ne sunulur. mektup hazırlanması, ruhsat sahibinin  Kapanış raporunda dağıtım ile ilgili genel bir değerlendirme yapılır farmakovijilans yetkilisi (dağıtım yolu, varsa hangi internet sitelerinde duyurusunun ve bir üst amiri tarafından yapıldığı), dağıtım işleminin hangi tarihte başlayıp kaç gün içinde imzalanması ve dağıtım tamamlandığına dair bilgiler, teslimata ait istatistiki veriler yapılması
rows.location: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)

Single-product condition comes from the branch label (line above, not in quote); stated in applicability. "farmakovijilans yetkilisi" = QPPV correct. Double-check: below 90: flow-chart quote with mixed columns (closure-report text interleaved); single-product condition from branch label outside quote; level inferred from chart. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.

[Interleaved from the adjacent column:] ...is submitted to the Department of Pharmacovigilance and Controlled Substances. The closure report gives an overall evaluation of the distribution (distribution route, any websites on which it was announced), information on the date on which distribution started and within how many days it was completed, statistical data on delivery...

f.title: Submit the DHPC distribution closure report within 15 working days
f.statement: The closure report on letter distribution is submitted to the Department of Pharmacovigilance and Controlled Substances within 15 working days. It gives an overall evaluation of distribution (route, websites where announced), the start date and number of days to complete distribution, delivery statistics (e.g. delivery percentage, target audience size, percentage of unreachable recipients) and any problems encountered; if distributed by e-mail, e-mail receipt and read information is added to the report.
f.clause: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)
f.applicability: Original language Turkish. Annex II flow chart; both branches (single- and multi-product) end with "Kapanış raporunun hazırlanarak Kuruma sunulması".

rows.deadline: Within 15 working days (clock start not stated)
rows.quote: Mektup dağıtımına ait kapanış raporu 15 iş günü içerisinde Ruhsat sahibi antetli Farmakovijilans ve Kontrole Tabi Maddeler Dairesi'ne sunulur. mektup hazırlanması, ruhsat sahibinin  Kapanış raporunda dağıtım ile ilgili genel bir değerlendirme yapılır farmakovijilans yetkilisi (dağıtım yolu, varsa hangi internet sitelerinde duyurusunun ve bir üst amiri tarafından yapıldığı), dağıtım işleminin hangi tarihte başlayıp kaç gün içinde imzalanması ve dağıtım tamamlandığına dair bilgiler, teslimata ait istatistiki veriler yapılması (dağıtımların teslimat yüzdesi gibi, hedeflenen kitle sayısı, ulaşılamayan alıcıların yüzdesi gibi), varsa süreç içinde karşılaşılan sorunlar sunulur. Dağıtım e-posta yolu ile yapılacaksa e-posta gönderim raporlarına ait e-posta alınma ve okunma bilgileri kapanış raporuna ilave edilir.
rows.location: Annex II DHPC distribution scheme (flow chart text; columns interleaved in source)
rows.review_note: Review: Deadline kept as 15 working days with clock start not stated (likely completion of distribution, not stated). Quote interleaved with other flow-chart column. Added data elements. Double-check: below 90: flow-chart quote with interleaved column text; 15-working-day clock start not stated in source (deadline says so); level from prescriptive present "sunulur". Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The closure report on the letter distribution is submitted to the Department of Pharmacovigilance and Controlled Substances within 15 working days. [Interleaved from the adjacent flow-chart column: preparation of a letter on the marketing authorisation holder's letterhead, signature by the marketing authorisation holder's pharmacovigilance officer and his/her superior, and distribution.] The closure report gives an overall evaluation of the distribution (distribution route, any websites on which it was announced), information on the date on which distribution started and within how many days it was completed, statistical data on delivery (such as the delivery percentage of distributions, the size of the target audience, the percentage of recipients who could not be reached), and any problems encountered during the process are presented. If distribution is made by e-mail, the e-mail receipt and read information from the e-mail delivery reports is added to the closure report.
